levels.title: A New Ripple
levels.hint: Tap behind the marble to roll it into the matching ring.
levels.narrative: Luma: That spark answers you. Send it toward the ring and see what wakes up.
levels.before: That little receiver can't hear the Current anymore. Try sending your ripple behind the marble.
levels.after: It worked. You actually woke it up.
levels.fragment: A single receiver re-established a path through the Landing Beacon.

levels.title: The Flowing Path
levels.hint: Start the marble toward the bright arrows. The moving water carries it the rest of the way.
levels.narrative: Luma: The water still remembers where to go.
levels.before: The water remembers its path. It just needs a little help to reach the reservoir.
levels.after: There it goes. I almost forgot how the reservoir sounded.
levels.fragment: The Glass Reservoir still held enough water to feed the islands.

levels.title: Beneath the Surface
levels.hint: Aim on the upper terrace. The ramp drops to a lower current that carries the marble home.
levels.narrative: Luma: The channel runs under this terrace. Follow the water down.
levels.before: There’s a mark on the lower channel. I can almost read it from here.
levels.after: Interrupted? That's strange. Someone told the water to stop.

levels.title: Reconnect the Stream
levels.hint: Send marble 1 across the pressure plate. Once the lower channel lights up, send marble 2 through it.
levels.narrative: Luma: A disconnected route can still carry power. Check that plate.
levels.before: These paths depend on each other. We have to wake them in the right order.
levels.after: I remember this sound. It used to mean everything was connected.
levels.fragment: The relay chime belonged to the old network. Luma remembers the sound, though its source is still unfamiliar.

levels.title: Guardian of the Aqueduct
levels.hint: Reconnect the intake, relay, and crown. Each plate powers the next channel. Dock all three marbles.
levels.narrative: Luma: The aqueduct is its own guardian. Give each part of the network a path to the next.
levels.before: Intake feeds the relay. The relay feeds the crown. I remember the pattern… and I don't remember why it frightens me.
levels.after: We brought the water back. Did you see the green light?
levels.fragment: The Crown received a return pulse from Eco Canopy, then a warning about uncontrolled growth.

milestones.name: Dormant
milestones.detail: Only residual flow reaches the islands.

milestones.name: First Spark
milestones.detail: A signal reaches the first island.

milestones.name: Water Returns
milestones.detail: Water spills from the reservoir into the Current.

milestones.name: Hidden Connection
milestones.detail: The terminal traces a concealed branch of the network.

milestones.name: Aqueduct Awakening
milestones.detail: The turbine turns and the Crown begins to pulse.

milestones.name: Aero Haven Restored
milestones.detail: The Crown sends a live signal to Eco Canopy.
